chat.body: Why does update look the trainer up only when trainerId is not null?

`PokemonService.update()` calls `this.trainers.find()` only when `changes.trainerId != null`. A body with `"trainerId": null` passes `@IsOptional()`, and `Object.assign()` copies the null onto the Pokemon, so the save writes `NULL` and the Pokemon has no trainer. There is no trainer to look up in that case.
